sections.intent: Curious toy-scale opening with sparse high glockenspiel and pizzicato.
Bright playful building phrase; each layer snap on two-beat grid. Motif grows into pride then wobble.
Cut music dead at failure; only plastic collapse, room tone and quiet clock. Narration remains dry.
Same theme returns quietly with the deliberate pickup/rummage and hopeful rebuild.
Music withdraws again. Low heartbeat, filtered radio countdown and Quindar.
Heroic major orchestral release on ignition, brass and strings carry tracked flight.
Warm landing, softened phrase, one red brick begins another ambition.
Scale-reveal orchestral resolution; strong final chord at51.71 end card, decay.

sound_design_requirements: Do not use the original MacLeod recordings or original master. New melody follows the playful/recovery/heroic arc.
Hard-cut musical tails at17.375s; room tone and clock remain.
Radio countdown uses bandpass380–2800Hz, soft saturation and Quindar beeps.
Plastic clicks should include2.9kHz/4.6kHz resonances; chorus of separate clacks during collapse, not one genericimpact.
Ignition36.5 has low boom/roar, followed by sustained softer thrust through landing.
